tirtl.assessment: 504 inbound (EB) is INCOMPLETE / UNRELIABLE in the AM peak: on the target day it collapses mid-peak (see am_reliability) and its day total is well below outbound; the same pattern appears on the comparison day (same weekday a week earlier). Either the logger undercounts in stop-and-go traffic or flow really breaks down; we cannot tell which, so do not use 504 as a bound for the AM peak. 505 outbound (WB) looks plausible.
